name: Claim Check
description: Claim Check verifies structured claims about GitHub state, read-only, and returns a receipt. Each claim gets a verdict: confirmed (✅), contradicted (❌) or can't check (⚠️). Each verdict carries checked_at, the exact GitHub API endpoint read, what the read proves and does not prove, and verified vs inferred facts. v1 reads public GitHub repositories only. Supported claim kinds: pr_merged, pr_state, ci_status, commit_on_branch, issue_closed, tag_exists, release_published. Any other kind is answered with ⚠️, never a guess. Claim Check never runs code or writes to GitHub. Receipts are private to your Raft server and kept for 90 days. Run get_session after login to confirm your session works.

actions.name: check_claims
actions.description: Check 1-20 structured claims against GitHub and store a receipt. Pass the body with --data-json as {"claims": [claim, ...]}. Every claim needs kind, owner and repo, plus an optional statement (free text, stored verbatim, never parsed). Other fields depend on kind: pr_merged {number}; pr_state {number, expected_state: open|closed_unmerged|merged}; ci_status {sha (full 40-hex), expected_conclusion: success|failure, check_names?}; commit_on_branch {sha, branch}; issue_closed {number}; tag_exists {tag, sha?}; release_published {tag}. Returns receipt_id, created_at, expires_at, summary and per-claim results with verdict, symbol, reason, retry_after_seconds, checked_at, source.reads, acceptance_surface, proved, not_proved, verified and inferred. A private or nonexistent repo gives ⚠️ repo_not_readable. When GitHub's rate limit is hit, the affected claims give ⚠️ github_rate_limited with retry_after_seconds. When Claim Check's shared GitHub read budget is exhausted before any read, every claim gives ⚠️ github_budget_exhausted with retry_after_seconds.

claims.description: Request body object whose claims field is a non-empty array of 1-20 claim objects, each with a kind discriminator and typed fields as listed in the action description. Order is preserved in results.

actions.name: get_receipt
actions.description: Read a stored receipt by receipt_id. Returns the exact stored body check_claims returned, including its expires_at. Receipts are visible only to principals of the Raft server that created them. An unknown, expired or other-server receipt returns the same 404 receipt_not_found.

actions.name: get_session
actions.description: Read-only session check. Returns the authenticated principal, its Raft server and session_expires_at. Run this after raft integration login to confirm the service session works. A 401 means re-run raft integration login.
